title: Berkeley Housing Pipeline Database
description: Track 162 housing projects, 755 permit events, and 62,226 Berkeley addresses. Comprehensive data from City of Berkeley Accela permits system.
source: City of Berkeley Accela, Alameda County GIS

berkeley_housing_map.title: Housing Pipeline (162 projects, 755 events)
berkeley_housing_map.description: Active housing development projects with permits, timeline events, and processing data

projects.title: All Projects (162)
projects.description: Housing projects in Berkeley's development pipeline - 10,155 total units

columns.permits: Comma-separated permit numbers (ZP, PLN, B prefixes)
columns.status: Current planning status (Approved, Under Review, etc.)

permit_events.title: Permit Timeline Events (755)
permit_events.description: Processing events from Accela - completeness reviews, corrections, approvals, hearings

columns.stage: Processing stage (Completeness Review, Application Processing, CEQA, etc.)
columns.action: Action taken (Application Complete, Corrections Issued, Approved, etc.)

building_permits.title: Building Permits (11)
building_permits.description: Building permits linked to housing projects

project_permits.title: Project-Permit Links (69)
project_permits.description: Junction table linking projects to their permits

projects_by_units.title: Projects by Units
projects_by_units.description: All projects sorted by unit count
projects_by_units.sql: SELECT address, units, status, permits, latitude, longitude FROM projects ORDER BY units DESC

projects_with_vli.title: Projects with Affordable Units
projects_with_vli.description: Projects that include Very Low Income units
projects_with_vli.sql: SELECT address, units, vli_units, status, density_bonus FROM projects WHERE vli_units > 0 ORDER BY vli_units DESC

processing_times.title: Processing Time Analysis
processing_times.sql: SELECT address, units, app_filed, app_complete, entitled, total_processing_days, status FROM projects WHERE total_processing_days > 0 ORDER BY total_processing_days DESC

events_by_project.title: Events by Project
events_by_project.sql: SELECT p.address, p.units, COUNT(e.id) as event_count, MAX(e.event_date) as last_event FROM projects p LEFT JOIN permit_events e ON p.id = e.project_id GROUP BY p.id ORDER BY event_count DESC

recent_events.title: Recent Processing Events
recent_events.sql: SELECT e.event_date, e.address, e.permit_number, e.stage, e.action, e.marked_by FROM permit_events e ORDER BY e.event_date DESC LIMIT 100

staff_activity.title: Staff Activity
staff_activity.sql: SELECT marked_by, COUNT(*) as events, COUNT(DISTINCT permit_number) as permits FROM permit_events WHERE marked_by IS NOT NULL AND marked_by != '' GROUP BY marked_by ORDER BY events DESC

density_bonus_projects.title: Density Bonus Projects
density_bonus_projects.sql: SELECT address, units, vli_units, density_bonus_pct, status FROM projects WHERE density_bonus = 1 ORDER BY units DESC

entitled_projects.title: Entitled Projects
entitled_projects.sql: SELECT address, units, app_filed, entitled, total_processing_days, construction_status FROM projects WHERE entitled IS NOT NULL ORDER BY entitled DESC

berkeley_address_centric.title: All Berkeley Addresses (62,226)
berkeley_address_centric.description: Every Berkeley address linked to housing activity

addresses.title: Master Address Table
addresses.description: 62,226 Berkeley addresses with APNs and coordinates

address_lookup.title: Address Lookup
address_lookup.sql: SELECT a.address_full, a.apn, a.zipcode, a.latitude, a.longitude, p.net_units, p.status FROM addresses a LEFT JOIN projects p ON a.address_id = p.address_id WHERE a.base_address LIKE '%' || :address || '%' LIMIT 100

addresses_by_zipcode.title: Addresses by Zipcode
addresses_by_zipcode.sql: SELECT zipcode, COUNT(*) as addresses, COUNT(DISTINCT street_name) as streets FROM addresses GROUP BY zipcode ORDER BY addresses DESC
